description: What a Uniswap v4 hook on Arc is allowed to do, read from the permission bits in its address with no chain call: whether it runs on swaps or can rewrite amounts. A capability, not a verdict. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

hook.description: 0x hook address from the pool key

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
